function.name: SET_PANNING
function.param: Number of channel returned by PLAY_WAV
function.abstract: It changes the balance of a channel

description.p: This function allows to change the left/right positioning of a sound in stereo, simply adjusts the volume of each one of the two subchannels. If you want to play the sound with the volume of the beginning, you must use SET_PANNING(255,255).
